svg.desc: 1038 commits across five public projects, 73 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-13 through 2026-11-04 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-04T09:58:35.720Z.
